keyword: how long to fly to the moon
claims: A spacecraft typically takes about three days to travel from Earth to the Moon.
Apollo missions generally took about 69–75 hours to enter lunar orbit.
Artemis II is expected to take four to five days for a flyby mission.
Apollo 8 reached lunar orbit in 69 hours and 8 minutes.
Artemis I and Artemis II missions take 4 to 5 days.
New Horizons passed the moon in 8.5 hours in 2006.
